task_instance: Handle a pasted price/timing objection email from a prospect (Priya Nataraj at Brightleaf Logistics, pushing back on price vs. incumbent RouteWise and wanting to wait until contract renewal) using only a pasted objection and rep-stated deal context (files-only tier, no CRM/transcript/docs/email connectors), producing a classified objection, a talk-track response grounded in the customer's own stated pain points, sourced proof points, a don't-list, and an offer to draft a reply.
evidence: Created objection_email.txt (sample pasted customer objection) and deal_context.md (rep-stated deal context, standing in for the CRM/transcript fallback the skill's files-only tier explicitly supports) in the work directory. Produced objection_response.md following the skill's Step 1-4 structure: grounded the session (no connectors available), classified the objection as combined price/value + genuine timing objection (not a negotiation move), pulled the only available evidence (the customer's own stated dispatcher time cost and missed-window rate from deal_context.md) since win-loss/customer-voice/docs tools were unavailable and explicitly flagged those as gaps rather than fabricating quotes or stats, built a talk-track response anchored on the customer's own numbers ending in a forward question, listed sourced proof points and explicitly gapped unsourced ones, gave a don't-list, and left the reply as paste-ready text (not sent) since no email/draft-outreach connector was available. Verified by reading objection_response.md back in full - content is complete, internally consistent with the two input files, and does not invent any unvetted CRM/win-loss/customer-voice evidence. No shell/code execution, no binary files, and no MCP/connector tools were used, consistent with the office-assistant runtime and the files-only tier the skill document itself defines for when no connectors are present.
